coverage_screen.meaning: Permission to investigate a separate isolated runtime candidate, never runtime admission or a speedup prediction.

why: The preregistered coverage screen passes. All observed zero contributions are radical entries; neither opaque loop has one. Limit the next experiment to the two radical loops and retain opaque ownership and arithmetic unchanged.

next_step.name: coefficient-zero-radicals
next_step.change: Guard only the existing two borrowed radical linear loops with the opposite rational constant being nonzero. Keep the rational product, unsupported-product guard, radical cross-products, both opaque loops, term insertion order, normal-form budgets and original retry unchanged.
next_step.source_reasoning: Rational multiplication by stored zero returns the shared zero before canonicalization, product-cache lookup or publication. insert_radical immediately accepts and discards that zero before inspecting the radicand or term limit. The skipped radicand clone only increments its Arc count; the original vector remains owned through the unchanged cross-product loop. Thus the guard removes zero temporaries and radicand clone/drop pairs without changing nonzero arithmetic, input owners or certificate publication.
qualification: Fresh baseline and candidate from the frozen endpoint source, both with identical new tests and separate qualification/cost targets. No diagnostic counters, rejected scaling, merge or prepass code.

Exact zero/positive/negative rational scaling in both directions for radical, opaque and mixed coefficients; independent mixed-radical component products and cancellation; eight/nine-term success/decline; unsupported opaque products; zero and nonzero owner release; cold/warm/cloned facts.

The existing six retained-cache regressions include the mandatory original retry. Full scalar release all-feature library tests, 28 doctests, strict all-target/all-feature Clippy, formatting and warning-denied docs.
Three unchanged scalar probe suites with fixed five paired blocks, time and allocation modes, construction/first/warm/cloned/opaque and mixed-field controls; no extension to remove adverse rows.

Only a candidate supported by scalar costs advances to full native tests, five fixed native endpoint/broad blocks and effective final-abort controls, original 120-second board worker CPU and separate 60-second neck check-body wall assertions. Complete unnormalized reports and production binary size remain required for retention.
next_step.cost_risks: Two extra stored-sign branches affect nonzero and empty-vector cases. Zero multiplication is already cheap; no allocation or runtime improvement follows from coverage alone. The existing endpoint parent remains unadmitted and its earlier timing/memory tradeoffs remain open.

limits: The diagnostic adds synchronization overhead and is not a speedup benchmark. Input length sums happen to equal executed entry counts on these boards; the separate early-decline regression proves that equality is not a general invariant. Finding counts 12/197 do not establish complete report identity.
